name: lcc
description: Verbatim tool-call compaction for Claude Code sessions: Jev decides which tool calls and results are spent, everything kept stays byte for byte.

server.title: MCP server name
server.description: Name of the lcc MCP server as /mcp lists it. The plugin ships its own via .mcp.json, which Claude Code names plugin:lcc:lcc.

question.title: Objective
question.description: What the context must serve. Empty means: use the text after /compact, or the newest user prompts.

provider.title: Judge
provider.description: Which judge decides which tool calls are spent. 'auto' (default) and 'specialist-v3' use the local specialist-v3 ranker: offline, no key; it ranks, it does not judge (see docs/SPECIALIST.md). 'jev' is remote, needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY and runs only when chosen here. 'laya' is DEPRECATED (local, slow) and runs only when chosen here. 'rules' is an offline deterministic policy with no model and no key (mode set by rulesMode; see docs/REAL_SESSION_BENCHMARKS.md).

threshold.title: Keep threshold
threshold.description: A tool call or result below this keep-probability is a candidate for removal.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to pin
preserveRecentMessages.description: Newest messages never scored and never mutated (the first message is always pinned).

trimHeadChars.title: Trimmed result head
trimHeadChars.description: Characters kept from a result whose contents are spent but whose call still matters.

maxStateTokens.title: State budget (tokens)
maxStateTokens.description: Token ceiling for the conversation sent to the judge. A history that cannot fit falls back to the built-in summary.

maxRequestTokens.title: Request budget (tokens)
maxRequestTokens.description: Ceiling for the state plus one batch of questions per request (Jev allows 32K).

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction
minReductionRatio.description: Below this share of characters removed the plugin keeps Claude Code's built-in summary instead.

rulesMode.title: Rules mode
rulesMode.description: Only with provider 'rules': 'lossless', 'recoverable', 'stashed' or 'lossy'. Empty uses the server default (lossless). 'recoverable' sends the session directory as workspace_root, so every removed file read is checked against the disk. 'stashed' moves removed outputs to a local stash; the agent gets them back with the recall tool (allow mcp__plugin_lcc_lcc__recall).
